parsed.explanation: The quoted inference is false, exactly as the counterexample shows. Nevertheless, the surrounding case analysis establishes survival: when $g\ge2$, the first output $g$ exceeds 1; when $g=1$, the second output $mn$ exceeds 1. Thus no move outputs two 1s, so induction from the initially non-all-1 board gives at least one survivor after every move. Replacing the faulty sentence with this case-based argument repairs Step 2.
